diagnosis.headline: The contract refused the transaction and gave this reason: "BC".
diagnosis.why: The contract checked a condition, it was not met, and the contract stopped the transaction with the message "BC". Nothing was changed; you only paid the network fee.
fix: Change the input that the message points at (an amount, an address or a deadline) and send again.
If you did not expect this, ask the dApp's support, quoting the message and the transaction link.
evidence: replayed with eth_call at block 20567566 (the state the transaction started from), same sender, value, data and gas limit
